Model validations were conducted using modifications similar to those employed in the discharge cases. However, the key model difference was the use of the outdoor MCHX coil as the condenser during recharge operation. In contrast, the BPHX was used as an evaporator to solidify the PCM in the TES, as per the system design. Case #2C (Ambient DBT/WBT = 95°F/75°F, AHRI 210/240 A Test) is a continuous TES Full recharge case.
